newsitem.title: INDIA: India metals suffer losses on weak overseas market.
newsitem.headline: India metals suffer losses on weak overseas market.

text.p: Indian metals prices, led by copper, on Wednesday as weak trends in overseas markets prompted selling, dealers said.
Copper fell by 100 rupees at 13,700 rupees per quintal after losing 50 rupees on Tuesday.
"Other base metals too suffered a setback on the back of a falling world market while physical enquiries remained low," said Sharad Parikh, a leading dealer.
Tin slumped by 400 rupees to 29,200 rupees after losing 500 rupees last week while nickel fell by 200 rupees at 34,100 rupees per quintal after losing 500 rupees last week.
Zinc slid by 50 rupees at 8,100 rupees and lead fell by 25 rupees at 4,100 rupees per quintal nominally in sympathy.
Aluminium was quoted at the previous level of 7,700 rupees per quintal but volumes were low.
